name: docs-tools
description: The Markdown lint that pr-policy.yml's docs job runs in every repository, pinned with its whole dependency tree by the committed package-lock.json (engineering standard, E3 and 3.9; round 3, R3-B1). Installed with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`; never with npx. Vale and lychee are static binaries pinned by archive SHA-256 in the workflow.
